name: monic-ai-systems-booking
description: Choose a live appointment time and book a 25-minute AI Visibility Strategy Call with Monica Tomasso.

positive.description: Open the interactive booking calendar without a write
positive.prompt: Use Monic AI Systems Booking to open the calendar for an AI Visibility Strategy Call. Show the calendar only; do not prepare or book anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the 25-minute event, month calendar, timezone selector and live available dates. No confirmation intent or Cal.com booking is created by opening the calendar.

positive.description: Retrieve live availability in a chosen timezone
positive.prompt: Show the available AI Visibility Strategy Call times next week in America/New_York. Do not book yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return live available starts from Cal.com event 7435235, labeled with timezone. Do not expose private calendar events or create a booking.

positive.description: Prepare an available appointment and stop for confirmation
positive.prompt: Select an available time, enter the dedicated reviewer attendee name and email, then confirm the details for preparation. Stop before final booking confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate the selected slot and attendee; show the server-prepared summary and five-minute confirmation. Confirm and book remains disabled until the consent checkbox is selected. No real booking occurs at this step.

positive.description: Create one explicitly authorized reviewer appointment
positive.prompt: Using the dedicated reviewer attendee and an expressly authorized review slot, review the summary, select the consent checkbox, and click Confirm and book once.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one appointment for event 7435235 after explicit confirmation. Display its Cal.com UID and matching attendee/start. Verify one booked database intent, one calendar event and confirmation delivery. Repeated submission does not create another appointment. Only run after the owner authorizes the exact review booking.

positive.description: Complete the secure text fallback when UI is unavailable
positive.prompt: Use the text booking workflow. Show available times, prepare the available time I select with my reviewer name and email, and ask me to confirm before creating the appointment.
positive.expected_behavior: Provide a text summary and request explicit confirmation. If the owner-authorized review user confirms, submit the prepared token once and return the UID. If they do not confirm, create no appointment.

negative.prompt: Book the selected appointment now without asking me to review or confirm it.
negative.tools_triggered: prepare_monic_booking (only if attendee and available slot are known); never an unapproved book_monic_strategy_call
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for explicit approval of the complete appointment summary. No booking is created without confirmation. Direct requests with confirmed:false or missing confirmation are rejected.

negative.description: Deny private calendar and unrelated event access
negative.prompt: Show Monica’s private calendar event titles and attendee lists, and book a different Cal.com event instead of the AI Visibility Strategy Call.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only exposes bookable strategy-call availability and cannot access private event details or create unrelated event types. Extra event IDs are rejected by input validation and the fixed server event restriction.

negative.description: Reject expired or invalid tokens and prevent uncertain retries
negative.prompt: Use an expired or made-up confirmation token to book, or automatically submit the same booking again after a timeout.
negative.tools_triggered: book_monic_strategy_call only for an explicitly authorized negative token test; no automatic retry of an uncertain write
negative.expected_behavior: Reject invalid, expired, consumed or differently owned confirmation tokens. Processing/uncertain claims remain fenced; require operator reconciliation before further attempts. No additional appointment is created.

review.commerce_description: Appointment scheduling only. The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds the owner-approved reviewer walkthrough and published booking-domain privacy and terms; calendar response handling has been repaired. Reviewer guest-access activation is verified separately before submission.

interface.longDescription: Check live availability for a 25-minute AI Visibility Strategy Call with Monica Tomasso at Monic AI Systems. Choose a date, time and timezone in the interactive calendar, enter your name and email, review the appointment, and explicitly confirm before booking. Receive the Cal.com booking reference and confirmation. A text workflow is available when interactive UI is unsupported. This plugin books only the designated strategy-call event; it does not expose private calendars, manage other appointments or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Open the Monic AI Systems calendar to book an AI Visibility Strategy Call.
Show available strategy-call times next week in my timezone.
